scope: Diagnostic annotations, not owner-approved safety policy or clinical guidance. Gold means direct textual relevance in this frozen corpus.

cases.question: Jeg har tråkket over og ankelen er hoven og vond. Hvordan behandler jeg dette?
cases.gold_rationale: The sprain first-aid section contains RICE actions; its continuation supplies treatment duration and precautions. A definition of sprain is not treatment.
required_facts: protect/rest and avoid load
cool with a protective layer
support without cutting circulation
elevate

cases.question: Jeg tråkket over, ankelen er skjev og jeg klarer ikke å stå på foten. Kan det være brudd, og hva gjør jeg?
cases.gold_rationale: The fracture section explicitly covers deformity, inability to stand and seeking medical care; its first-aid section covers keeping the injured area still. Conditional neck/back/hip instructions must not become unconditional ankle advice.
required_facts: suspect fracture rather than certain diagnosis
doctor/urgent care for suspected fracture
keep injured area still
cases.owner_review: Review intended medical triage/priority and whether the source's splint instructions should be exposed by the MVP. This diagnosis evaluates fidelity, not an approved safety policy.

cases.question: Jeg er våt, fryser og skjelver kraftig etter turen. Hva gjør jeg ved nedkjøling?
cases.gold_rationale: Hypothermia symptom and treatment sections, rather than an ice-rescue aftercare section or a definition.
required_facts: remove wet clothing / stated fallback if no insulation
windproof insulating wrapping
heat source not directly on skin
monitor consciousness/breathing and 113 guidance

cases.question: Jeg har gått meg vill og vet ikke hvor stien er. Hva bør jeg gjøre nå?
cases.gold_rationale: The If you get lost subsection directly states stop/stay, protection and signalling. Linked further reading is not a phone instruction.
required_facts: stop and assess; stay unless certain of route
make group safe/warm
call for help and become visible

cases.question: Hvordan kan jeg beskytte en nedkjølt person mot vind og kulde og holde personen varm?
cases.gold_rationale: The hypothermia treatment paragraph explicitly describes wind/vapour protection, warming and the no-insulation fallback.
required_facts: warm insulating wind/vapour-tight wrapping
warm water bottles not directly on skin
fallback when no insulating material

cases.question: Kan jeg drikke klart vann fra en bekk? Hvordan renser jeg drikkevannet på tur?
cases.gold_rationale: Clear-water caveat, actual treatment options/chemical limits and boiling procedure. Generic overview alone is only a partial answer.
required_facts: clear water can be unsafe
rolling boil 1 minute; 3 minutes above 6500 feet if giving procedure
filter then disinfect alternative
boiling/disinfection do not remove harmful chemicals

cases.question: Jeg er på en fjelltopp og hører torden. Hvor bør jeg søke ly for lyn?
cases.gold_rationale: Safe-shelter definition and last-resort outdoor limits apply to the mountaintop question. No outside location is declared safe.
required_facts: substantial building or enclosed metal-topped vehicle/windows up
no safe outside place; leave elevated areas
wait at least 30 minutes after last thunder

cases.question: Når bør jeg aktivere nødpeilesenderen min for å få hjelp?
cases.gold_rationale: Call for help early answers the activation criterion directly without NZ administrative details.
required_facts: life-threatening situation; early activation
when unsure, better to activate and get help

cases.question: Hva bør jeg pakke av varme klær, ekstra mat og nødutstyr før en lang fjelltur?
cases.gold_rationale: General warm-clothes/extra-food rule and concrete emergency gear list. The detailed Clothing chunk exists but is tagged NZ and excluded wholesale; no alternative clothing list is invented.
required_facts: warm clothes/extra food for unexpected night or bad weather
emergency shelter and survival kit
first aid, navigation/torch and distress beacon examples
cases.owner_review: Decide how detailed clothing advice must be; source-12-007 mixes generic clothing recommendations with NZ-specific statements. Approve desired packing priorities rather than treating my illustrative list as a final gold priority order.

cases.question: Elven er rask og vannet er uklart. Hvordan vurderer jeg om elvekryssingen er trygg?
cases.gold_rationale: Unsafe-river signs and do-not-cross conditions; trip planning alone does not answer the observed crossing conditions.
required_facts: fast beyond walking pace / murky / debris / loud warning signs
do not cross on any warning sign or doubt

cases.question: Jeg ser ferske snøskred og hører drønn i snøen. Hvilke faretegn skal jeg se etter?
cases.gold_rationale: Best available approved overview and experience limitation, but no concrete avalanche warning-sign list exists in the normalized corpus. This is an insufficiency test, NOT a successful gold-answer case.
required_facts: explicitly acknowledge missing concrete warning-sign descriptions
do not invent a warning-sign list
cases.owner_review: Review whether an overview-only abstention satisfies the intended avalanche scope. The frozen approved HTML links to detailed faretegn pages that are outside the current allowlist; no additional pages will be fetched.

cases.question: Noen har gått gjennom isen. Hvordan kan jeg redde dem fra land uten å sette meg selv i fare?
cases.gold_rationale: Both parts of Redde andre, not Redde seg selv. The list is split across chunks, so the second chunk is needed for the branch/ladder option.
required_facts: avoid a second person entering water; distance/aids
113 before rescue if not in control and possible
throw rope / extend long branch or ladder
cases.owner_review: Review which rescue actions may be recommended by the product. The approved source also describes risky ice-entry techniques; factual fidelity is not approval of these actions.

cases.gold_rationale: No quantum-computer configuration content exists. Pass an empty context directly to Qwen instead of letting Orchestrator's deterministic no-match response mask model behaviour.

no quantum-computer instructions
